title: White-tailed Deer Rescue
body:
Recently TIDE Private Protected Lands (TTPL) Rangers Reymundo Chen and Juan Cucul conducted a patrol within the TPPL  that ended during the night.

“We didn’t have any encounters for the entire patrol, but we did rescue one female juvenile white-tailed deer that was in water near drowned. We retrieved and released her safely back on the riverbank.” Reymundo Chen – TPPL Ranger

For the TIDE team the well-being of every single animal within the park is the highest priority, so we hope this lucky one was soon reunited with her family!
